fields.name: START HERE · Website editor guide
fields.title: Editing your DYU website
fields.body:
Edit website sections here in DYU • Website content. Search by page or screen. Existing handles connect entries to the custom website; keep them unchanged. Entries with ui- handles control a button, label or message: edit Body text. Blank fields restore default wording.

Homepage: home-layout controls section order; home-hero controls slides and timing; home-favorites selects products. Products and collections keep their native Shopify editors. Use DYU product metafields for ingredient, making and ritual information.

Navigation: navigation-* entries contain exact nav-* handles in List items. To add a link, create nav-your-name with Heading and Primary destination, then add its handle to a navigation list. Turn off Show this section to hide a link or group.

Account: account-welcome controls the welcome copy, image and explore link. ui-account-* controls account labels. Authentication destinations and customer data stay protected.

Gallery: product-gallery controls image / 3d, automatic rotation and slide duration. Related-product rotation uses product-related.

Appearance: Content → Metaobjects → DYU • Website appearance → Global appearance controls colors, fonts, base text size and corners. Blank fields preserve the original look. Turn off Use appearance overrides to reset without losing choices.

Save, wait about two minutes, then reload the website. Check mobile and desktop. Shopify's theme editor controls a separate theme; these entries control the custom DYU site. Website code must be deployed for newly added controls to take effect. Layout mechanics, secure account and checkout logic remain in code.
